---
name: A directive or behaviour is missing
about: Something the module should be able to do and cannot
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do**
<!-- The setup you are building, not the directive you have in mind.
     There is often a way already, and if there is not, this is what
     decides what the new one should look like. -->


**What you do instead today**
<!-- A workaround that exists and merely annoys is a different case from
     something that cannot be done at all. -->


**How you would shape it**
<!-- Optional.  A directive name, the context it would live in, what it
     would take. -->
